name: cli-agent-runner
description: Run scoped Grok, Claude, Codex, or custom CLI workers with CLI Agent Runner: run one worker or orchestrate parent-declared independent leaf jobs in parallel, sharing its default-on Codex IAB Live Console. Trigger on CLI Agent Runner, Live Console, Grok/Claude CLI, custom runner JSON, or .cli-agent-runner continuation; explicit silent/no-console requests are the only OFF path; excludes generic coding and ordinary official subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Run one worker or parallel independent leaf jobs with a default-on IAB Live Console.
interface.longDescription: CLI Agent Runner is an explicit process-runner workflow for scoped CLI workers. `run --runner <id>` launches exactly one worker; `orchestrate --runner <id> --jobs-file <json>` concurrently launches parent-declared independent leaf jobs from a version-1 jobs file. The parent first derives human responsibility owners and their dependency graph, then splits only workstreams with stable handoffs and non-overlapping writable scopes when that materially reduces elapsed time; tightly coupled work remains with one owner. A hierarchy permission ceiling controls descendants only and never substitutes for sibling-job dispatch. It bundles Codex, Claude, and Grok profiles, accepts additional or overridden profiles from runner JSON, and invokes every profile through one validated command-and-arguments path. It starts and opens one token-protected Codex IAB Live Console at skill selection before worker preparation, keeps it alive across user-confirmation pauses, restores or reopens it before resuming, streams emitted stdout/stderr or structured messages, and shares it across all jobs with per-job run IDs. It enforces a machine-checkable repository scope. A successful run or orchestration records its minimal completed result and stops without a follow-up collection, finalization, reviewer, or validator chain. Direct runner commands also own a console by default; only explicit silent or no-console selection disables it. It does not replace generic coding or ordinary official-subagent routing.
capabilities: Codex, Claude, And Grok CLI Worker Launch
Default-On Prestarted Token-Protected IAB Live Console
Live Console Continuity Across User-Input Pauses
Provider-Neutral Text And JSON Event Streaming
Terminal Minimal Result For Successful Runs
